videos.title: Homcom Realtors, Mohali — vertical site-visit promo
videos.summary: 64.8s 9:16 real-estate promo. ~16 bold uppercase white text beats over stills of towers and aerials, one beat every ~4s, brand mark top-centre on every beat, slow push on each still, slow dissolves rather than hard cuts (only 1 detected cut, at 58.4s). Ends with a 6.4s end card: circular logo, 'book your site visit', phone, Instagram handle and address. Continuous music/VO bed at -17 dB mean.
